title: 茶經
summary: "茶經" by Lu Yu is a monograph written between 760 and 762 CE during the Tang dynasty. As the world's first known treatise on tea and tea culture, it explores the origins, cultivation, and preparation of tea across ten chapters. Lu Yu treats tea as a symbol of universal harmony, blending horticultural knowledge with philosophical insight.
